newsitem.title: USA: Smart World offers NYC "free" Internet access.
newsitem.headline: Smart World offers NYC "free" Internet access.

text.p: Smart World Communications said Thursday it has established a hub and local access number for New York City's 212 area code so that people can use its advertiser-supported software without monthly charges.

The Internet service provider said it can offer NetRacer software for Internet and e-mail without any monthly fees or ongoing service charges because it sells full-screen interactive advertisements to sponsors.
The software holds a one-time fee of $69.95 and a one-time registration fee of $19.95.
